newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks fall 1.16 pct by midday.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks fall 1.16 pct by midday.

text.p: Thai stocks extended losses by the midday break on Friday on heavy selling of communications stocks which announced weak first quarter earnings, brokers said.
The SET index declined 6.49 points, or 1.16 percent, to 551.38 on moderate 2.1 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index dipped 0.56 to 39.84.
"Telecommunication shares led the market fall. Their profits in the first quarter were quite low," said a broker at SITCA Investment and Securities.
